So a=11, b=9, c=0, and a+b+c = 20.

Solution A makes errors in its expansion (it wrongly distributes terms, e.g. 2√2 + 3√2 instead of 5√2 and so on), giving 23√2 + 18√3, which is incorrect. Solution B incorrectly computes 5·2√6 = 10√6 and 2√6·√3 etc., treating the products wrongly, giving 26, which is also incorrect.

Neither is correct. Checking which is closer: the correct answer is 20. A gives 41, B gives 26. Neither matches, but I must choose one; B is closer numerically, though it has no principled advantage.
